title: Panda dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- dance floor sparkles -->
    <circle cx='20' cy='88' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <circle cx='80' cy='88' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='92' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='20' fill='#f4f4f4'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='20' fill='none' stroke='#d0d0d0' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- belly -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='11' ry='11' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- legs -->
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='82' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#5a5a8a' transform='rotate(-20 38 82)'/>
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='78' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#5a5a8a' transform='rotate(25 62 78)'/>
    <!-- arms -->
    <ellipse cx='26' cy='52' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#5a5a8a' transform='rotate(35 26 52)'/>
    <ellipse cx='74' cy='50' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#5a5a8a' transform='rotate(-40 74 50)'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='20' fill='#f4f4f4'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#d0d0d0' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx='33' cy='15' r='7' fill='#5a5a8a'/>
    <circle cx='67' cy='15' r='7' fill='#5a5a8a'/>
    <!-- eye patches -->
    <ellipse cx='41' cy='30' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#5a5a8a' transform='rotate(-15 41 30)'/>
    <ellipse cx='59' cy='30' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#5a5a8a' transform='rotate(15 59 30)'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='42' cy='29' r='2.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='29' r='2.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='42.5' cy='28.5' r='1.3' fill='#22223a'/>
    <circle cx='58.5' cy='28.5' r='1.3' fill='#22223a'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#5a5a8a'/>
    <!-- big smile -->
    <path d='M43 41 Q50 48 57 41' fill='none' stroke='#5a5a8a' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- rosy cheeks -->
    <circle cx='34' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  </g>
</svg>
